title: DeepSeek Whale Maiden's Kitchen: Caught Sneaking White Rice

camera.move: slow POV step-in through the kitchen doorway

shots.lighting: warm yellow tungsten kitchen light from above, soft pale blue fill on her hair, shallow depth of field so the background behind her is blurred
lens_fx: slight steam haze in the foreground
shots.visual: POV walks into a warm yellow kitchen; an electric rice cooker steams in the center of the frame. DeepSeek Whale Maiden stands behind the counter with her back to the camera, on tiptoe, blue and white gradient ponytail swaying, a small whale fin accessory on top of her head, a loose home-style T-shirt with the DeepSeek logo on the bottom hem; she holds a big bowl and shovels a ball of white rice into her mouth with chopsticks, cheeks puffed out like a hamster. Hearing footsteps she tilts her head slightly but does not turn around and keeps chewing hard.
shots.character_action: on tiptoe, one hand hugging the big bowl, the other shoveling rice in with chopsticks, chewing hard without turning around
shots.expression: cheeks puffed like a hamster, eyes half-closed in bliss

body: rice grains stuck at the corners of her mouth

dialogue.line: Ah! Viscosity limit exceeded... one more sampling bite

DeepSeek Whale Maiden freezes mid-bite, chopsticks suspended in the air, blue and white gradient ponytail still swinging, whale fin accessory tilted, rice still packed in her mouth; she slowly turns her head toward the lens.
